svg.title: Five rhythm bands: rhythms and example contexts
svg.desc: Five equal-amplitude illustrative sine waves over one second at 2, 6, 10, 20 and 40 hertz. Text gives selected EEG contexts, not a sleep-to-alertness ranking or effects of auditory stimulation.

g.text: Five rhythm bands, with example contexts
Frequency describes a signal. Its meaning also depends on location, timing and task.
Theta also appears in waking memory tasks.
Posterior rhythm, especially with eyes closed.
Gamma is studied in local processing.
Observed brain-rhythm associations; no listening effect is implied.
Schematic waves, not recordings. App band boundaries shown; conventions vary.
